FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 801 KAMGRARA 2017
Dated:11-01-2018 regarding altering the limits of BILUGALI village of
Nanjanagudu Taluk and Mysore District and constituting a new revenue village
called JEEMARAHALLI was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No.
RD 801KAMGRARA 2017 dated:22-03-2018 inviting objections or suggestions
from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its
publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Mysore
district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 22-03-2018 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village BILUGALI of Nanjanagud talukMysoredistrict to form a new revenue
(11606)

won ed BMF UE TWAS, ME, 2, BAN, 909% ANLOS
village called as JEEMARAHALLI of Nanjanagud Taluk Mysore District along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification RD 798 KAMGRARA 2017 Dated 11-01-
2018 regarding altering the limits of Hunasavadi village of Periyapatna Taluk and
Mysore District and constituting a new revenue village called Nandinathpura was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. 1637 Part IV-A dated 28-
12-2017 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected
thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette
addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Mysore district.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 15-03-2018 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village of Periyapatna Taluk in Mysore District to form a new revenue village called
as Nandinathpura of Periyapatna Taluk and Mysore District. The new survey numbers
which will form part of this new village are as specified in column (4) thereof

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Dadadahalli Village of
Saligrama Taluk, Mysore District and to constitute a new revenue villages called
Madapura as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers
and new assigned to them.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Mysore District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Dadadahalli village of Mysore District Saligrama Taluk to form a new revenue
village called Madapura Village of Saligrama Taluk, Mysore District along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No: RD 561 KAMGRARA 2017 Dated:
04-08-2017 regarding altering the limits of Arasapura village of Koratagere Taluk
and Tumkur District and constituting a new revenue village called Arasapura
Thanda was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act,
1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 561
KAMGRARA 2017 Dated: 24-08-2017 inviting objections or suggestions from all
the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its
publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Tumkur
district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 21-10-2017 And whereas, no objections or suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1

specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Arasapura of Koratagere taluk in Tumkur District to form a new revenue
village called as Arasapura Thanda of Koratagere taluk Tumkur District along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Rajagondanahalli village of
Channagiri Taluk Davangere District and to constitute a new revenue villages
called Sevapura and Bapujinagara as specified in schedule along with maps
with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Davangere
District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Rajagondanahalli of Channagiri Taluk Davangere District to form a new
revenue village called as Sevapura of Channagiri Taluk Davangere District
along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the, Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Shivapura Village of
Holalkere taluk Chitradurga District and to constitute a new revenue villages
called Maruthi nagara as specified in schedule.

Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of
Shivapura village for conversion of Maruthi nagara unrecorded habitation in to
hamlet/part of the said revenue village.
Now , therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to
be affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or
after thirty days from the date of publication of the notification in the official
Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the
date Specified above will be considered by the state Government.
Objection or suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner, Chitradurga District.

SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of called Maruthi nagara village of
Holalkere Taluk of Chitradurga District convert the same to form hamlet within the
boundary of Shivapura Revenue village and same will herein after be named as
called Maruthi nagara of Shivapura village in Holalkere Taluk of Chitradurga
District.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose
s to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Ankasandra village of
Chikkanayakanahalli Taluk of Tumkur District and to constitute a new revenue
villages called Ankasandra Gollarahatti as specified in schedule.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of of

Ankasandra village for conversion of Ankasandra Gollarahatti unrecorded
habitation in to hamlet part of the said revenue village.

Now , there fore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the
said Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely
to be affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or
after thirty days from the date of publication of the notification in the official
Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the
date Specified above will be considered by the state Government.
Objection or suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner, Tumkur District.

SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared ashabitation area of Ankasandra Gollarahatti village of
Chikkanayakanahalli Taluk of Tumkur District convert the same to form hamlet/
part within the boundary of Ankasandra Revenue village and same will herein after
be named as called Ankasandra Gollarahatti of Ankasandra village in
Chikkanayakanahalli Taluk Tumkur District.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land

Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Pattanagere Village of
Kadur Taluk Chikkamagalur District and to constitute a new village called
NilegowdayyaanaKoppalu as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and new assigned to them.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Chikkamagalur
District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village of Pattanagere Village of Kadur Taluk Chikkamagalur to form a new
revenue village called Nilegowdayyaana Koppalu Village of Kadur Taluk
Chikkamagalur District along with the survey numbers included in column (4)
thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the, Government of Karnataka
propose s to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Sanklapura village of

Kadur taluk of Chikmagaluru District and to constitute a new revenue villages
called Bhovi Colony as specified in schedule.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of
Sanklapura village for conversion of Bhovi Colony unrecorded habitation in to
hamlet/part of the said revenue village.

Now , therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to
be affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or
after thirty days from the date of publication of the notification in the official
Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the
date Specified above will be considered by the state Government.
Objection or suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner, Chikmagaluru District.
SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column (3) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of called Bhovi Colony village Kadur
taluk of Chikmagaluru District convert the same to form hamlet/part within the
boundary of Sanklapura Revenue village and same will here in after be named as
called Bhovi Colony of Sanklapura village Kadur taluk, Chikmagaluru district..
